thread:
netops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for eu-west-1 serving cluster. Spike started 1744532888. Service: inference-api. Potential cross-region routing anomaly detected by traceroutes. Pager sent to @eng-oncall :rotating_light:

maya.h: I see the alert. Confirming — Grafana shows 5xx up to 18% for eu-west-1 over last 3m. Latency to eu-west also increased.

sam.k: Traces show a lot of requests destined for eu-west-1 being routed to us-west-2 nodes and then proxied back. That's causing request amplification and timeouts.

eng-oncall: On it. Jumping into traceroute and LB logs. Can someone drop the latest route table for the edge routers?

ryan: Pasting recent router dump (trimmed):
```
2025-01-15T14:21:02Z EDGE1 eu-west-1 -> NEXT-HOP us-west-2 (latency 230ms)
2025-01-15T14:21:04Z EDGE2 eu-west-1 -> NEXT-HOP eu-west-1 (latency 24ms)
2025-01-15T14:21:05Z EDGE3 eu-west-1 -> NEXT-HOP us-west-2 (latency 240ms)
```

maya.h: Looks like some edges are applying the latency-based policy incorrectly — they're evaluating stale health metrics and choosing us-west. Could be the new routing-policy rollout from last night.

eng-oncall: Agree. I can see the rollout id rp-2025-01-14-07. Rolling back to rp-2025-01-13 now.

netops-bot: ACTION: rollback routing policy rp-2025-01-14-07 initiated by eng-oncall at 1744532946.

support-lead: Noted. Customer-impact: high for EU customers using streaming endpoints; some reports of timeouts and truncated streams. Escalating to SEs.

sam.k: I'm going to temporarily pin traffic to eu-west-1 by setting region_override for the route group to eu-west-1 until rollback finishes. This avoids cross-region hop.

eng-oncall: Do it. Add a 5-min TTL to avoid long cache effects.

ryan: region_override command executed:
```
> rbcli route set --group streaming --region eu-west-1 --ttl 300
Success: region_override active
```

maya.h: Monitoring metrics. 5xx rate trending down from 18% -> 7% in last 90s. Latency tail is improving.

eng-oncall: Rollback of rp-2025-01-14-07 completed at 1744533058. netops-bot, confirm no remaining nodes with bad policy.

netops-bot: CHECK: edge policy diffs show rp-2025-01-13 active on 98% edges, 2% still applying update. Health check queued to finish.

sam.k: For the 2% stragglers I pushed a forced sync.

sam.k: Forced sync results:
```
> rbcli sync-edges --force --filter eu-west
Sync started
Synced: EDGE1, EDGE3
```

eng-oncall: Good. Can we rollback the temporary region_override now? Want normal routing back once everything leveled.

ryan: TTL expired in 3m, but I'll explicitly remove to be safe.

ryan: region_override removal: `rbcli route unset --group streaming --region_override` -> Success.

maya.h: Post-mitigation metrics: 5xx back to baseline (~0.8%), p95 latency stable. No further user reports in last 10m.

support-lead: Opening incident ticket INC-2025-0123 with customer impact notes and timeline. Sending out status update to customers: "We experienced elevated errors in EU due to a routing policy rollout causing cross-region misrouting. We have rolled back the policy and mitigated via temporary region pinning. Services are restored; we continue to monitor."

eng-oncall: Root cause hypothesis: routing-policy rollout used latency-sample with a stale geolocation feed combined with a bug in the selection code that preferred lower-reported latency even if health checks flagged node as degraded. Need postmortem.

sam.k: Filed internal bugs: RTE-7892 (routing selection preferring stale latencies), RTE-7893 (rollout validation missing health-check gating).

maya.h: Action items:
- postmortem draft (eng-oncall)
- add stronger rollout gating for health-checks (eng-runtime)
- improve canary size/monitoring for routing policy (netops)
- verify DNS TTL behavior doesn't prolong pinning (platform)

eng-oncall: Handoff to night oncall @sam.k for 2h watch. I'll update the incident channel if anything flips.

sam.k: On watch. Monitoring dashboards and traces.

support-lead: Will follow up with customers in 1h with a more detailed timeline.

netops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Condition cleared at 1744536123. Final note: rollback + region pin avoided >30min of EU disruption.

eng-oncall: Thanks team. Postmortem owners assigned; please add notes to the doc at /internal/incidents/INC-2025-0123 once available.

maya.h: Adding a quick mitigation playbook entry to runbook: "If cross-region hop spike observed, check routing-policy rollouts -> rollback -> region_override -> forced edge sync"

sam.k: Closing thread, will reopen if anything else appears. :white_check_mark:
